description: Use this when the user asks about one order of theirs: whether it is paid or confirmed, its terms, or what cancelling it would cost. It returns the order by orderId: its status, the payment status and, while it awaits payment, its payment link; the stay, its guests and its terms; whether it can be cancelled now, for which penalty and refund, or closed; why a failed order booked nothing and what a cancellation kept; and the hotel's confirmation number once there is one. It shows whether a payment went through.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.
